description: Main script for Hangman game handling DOM interactions, game logic, scene setup, data fetching, and user input.

methods.name: updateCurrent
methods.description: Selects a new random word index.

methods.name: getRandomWord
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a random word from the words list.

methods.name: reduceGuesses
methods.description: Decrements guesses and updates display.

methods.name: resetGuesses
methods.description: Resets guesses to initial value and updates display.

methods.name: increaseScore
methods.description: Increases score by given value and updates display.

methods.name: resetScore
methods.description: Resets score to zero and updates display.

methods.name: updateBestScore
methods.description: Updates best score if current score exceeds it.

methods.name: handleTouchStart
methods.description: Handles touch start event for swipe detection.

methods.name: handleTouchMove
methods.description: Handles touch move event for swipe detection.

methods.name: handleTouchEnd
methods.description: Handles touch end event to trigger swipe actions.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a button.

methods.name: toggleNextButton
methods.description: Shows or hides the 'Next' button with animation.

methods.name: CreateNextButton
methods.description: Creates and sets up the 'Next' button with event handlers.

methods.name: checkAnswer
methods.description: Checks if selected letter is in the word, updates game state, and handles game over.

methods.name: hideLetters
methods.description: Hides a proportion of letters in the current word based on difficulty.

methods.name: clearPrevWord
methods.description: Removes previous word's letter elements from DOM.

methods.name: createLetterElements
methods.description: Creates DOM elements for each letter in the current word.

methods.name: nextWord
methods.description: Loads a new word, clears previous, and creates letter elements.

methods.name: setupScene
methods.description: Initializes scene elements and animations.

methods.name: animateScene
methods.description: Starts scene animations if paused.

methods.name: showMenu
methods.description: Displays the game menu modal.

methods.name: closeMenu
methods.description: Hides the game menu modal.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a given endpoint.

methods.name: fillData
methods.description: Populates words array from fetched data based on category.

methods.name: setupGame
methods.description: Prepares game state for a new round.

methods.name: startGame
methods.description: Begins the game, loads first word, and sets up scene.

methods.name: toggleMenuList
methods.description: Toggles visibility of category or difficulty menu lists.
